rationale.oversight-theater: Review exists but paradoxically fails to improve AI-output oversight/modification
rationale.automation-bias: Reviewed workers over-defer to AI, modifying its output less
rationale.counterpoint: Challenges assumption that review/accountability discourages AI outsourcing
rationale.method-experiment: Seven controlled between-subjects experiments manipulating review
rationale.risk-overreliance: Measures and demonstrates over-reliance on unmodified AI output
